text: Add Cash in Store (barcode cash deposit at Walgreens/CVS/Kroger/Dollar General/7-Eleven, funds in minutes) is a genuine differentiator for a branch-light bank [S041].
Automatic Savings rules (Autopilot, Paycheck Percentage, Recurring Transfers) layer behavioral tooling on plain internal transfers [S042].
Zelle flow includes QR 'My Code'/scan, contact pick, OTP step-up, and clear cancel/expiry rules; 4.8-star #1 Finance app with ~11M ratings [S001][S002][S064].
Wire online flow has a structured recipient-type model (title company / person / own linked account) with explicit per-type limits and email/text/push status alerts [S010][S011].
Bill Pay re-platformed ('New Bill Pay') with 365-day future dating, $100,000 per-transaction limit and $100 late-fee guarantee [S016][S074].
Mobile Deposit help documents a full rejection taxonomy and hold-notice behavior [S021].

Small-business 'Accounts Payable with Capital One' lets a business pay any vendor from a card, bank account or debit card with delivery as a single-use emailed virtual card (0%), ACH or paper check, synced to QuickBooks Online, with no subscription fee — card-funded AP 'even to vendors that don't accept cards' [S916].
Self-service Cashier's Check Kiosk in select Cafés (app + camera, $5,000/day) alongside web/app cashier's-check ordering [S913].
In-app temporary ATM withdrawal-limit increase with OTP and instant approval notification [S910].

No digital international wire or remittance for consumers: international wires are branch-only ($40) and Capital One branches exist in only a few states; SMB international wires are by branch or email request [S013][S034].
No instant outbound option for consumers (no push-to-card, no RTP/FedNow send product marketed); external ACH takes 1-3 business days [S008][S007].
Zelle terms exclude business use; no Zelle for Small Business product [S049].

No documented in-app scam/dispute reporting for Zelle or EFTs; Eno explicitly cannot take disputes; disputes and fraud are phone-first with several different numbers (800-655-2265, 1-888-464-0727, 1-866-536-9023, 877-383-4802) [S038][S046][S071][S013].

Small-business payments (ACH origination, bill pay, user permissions, dual approval) have almost no public help content; Intellix has no public user guide and its mobile app rates 2.9/5 [S035][S063][S075].
Bill Pay migration did not carry payees over — customers had to re-add every payee, with a temporary legacy list for ~6 weeks [S019].
External account linking capped at 3 accounts and buried under profile settings [S005].
Domestic wires cannot be cancelled once submitted; no recall workflow [S013][S074].

Help-center coverage gaps are structural, not pagination artifacts: of 78 Checking & Savings articles none covers eBills/autopay, canceling a scheduled transfer, canceling a Zelle payment or reporting a Zelle scam; the Small Business help center has 7 articles and none on ACH, bill pay, wires, approvals or permissions [S903][S920].

No feature-level release notes exist on either app store: 25 iOS releases in 2026 (6.38.0–6.56.1, roughly biweekly) all read 'Defect fixes / UI fixes' and Google Play's 'What's new' is generic, so money-movement changes cannot be dated from the stores [S925][S931].
Dual control for ACH/wires is available only to Intellix (treasury-management) clients; standard Capital One Business online banking documents user delegation but no maker/checker [S922].

Operator participant lists confirm RTP and FedNow membership but neither carries a send/receive-only column, and the bank's only instant-payment statement concerns receiving; outbound instant payments remain unverifiable [S901][S902][S924].

CORRECTION (replaces 'No instant outbound option for consumers…'): Beyond Zelle P2P, consumers have no instant outbound option: no push-to-card, no marketed RTP/FedNow send, and transfers to their own external accounts take 1–3 business days by ACH [S008][S007][S001].
Add Cash in Store retail cash network [S041].
Early Paycheck plus Paycheck Percentage auto-sweep on the same direct deposit [S024][S042].
Cardless ATM withdrawals at all Capital One ATMs [S082].
Dual-purpose external account linking ('Payments' vs 'Payments and Transfers') [S005].
Security > 'Linked Apps' consent hub for third-party wallets/aggregators [S053].
Paze wallet (EWS) activated inside Digital Wallet Manager; Discover cards 'coming soon' [S066].

Capital One's Discover-conversion page explicitly tells consumers their Capital One routing number 'may also qualify you to receive instant transfers from external accounts or third-party apps' — a rare consumer-facing acknowledgement of real-time inbound payments, framed as a conversion benefit [S924].
Intellix 'Dual Control Authorization' is marketed to small businesses on the SMB treasury-management page, positioning Intellix as the upgrade path for approval controls [S922].
Capital One is one of the seven bank owners of Early Warning Services, operator of Zelle and Paze [S952].
2025-05-18: Capital One completed acquisition of Discover Financial Services; Discover now 'a division of Capital One, N.A.' [S053][S054].
2025-03-31: Zelle now requires both parties enrolled through a participating bank (standalone Zelle app retired); reflected in Capital One Zelle FAQ [S001].
2025-11 (week of Nov 18): Capital One joined FedNow (mode undisclosed); already an RTP participant [S022][S025][S027].
2025-11-18: Capital One and Discover deposits jointly FDIC-insured [S054].
2025-2026: Bill Pay re-platformed to 'the New Bill Pay'; payees not migrated; 365-day future dating [S016][S019].
2026-04-27: Zelle Terms and Conditions updated (date on page) [S049].
2026-07-27 onward: Discover card accounts migrating to Capital One through 2027 [S052].

2026-08-23: First wave of Discover savings accounts converted to 360 Performance Savings; checking converting one account at a time; routing numbers change; Early Pay retired on savings [S050][S053][S051].
By 2026-11: Discover online-banking feature pages (Zelle, features, mobile app, Early Pay) redirect to Capital One pages [S058][S059][S060][S061].
Paze: Capital One live; Discover products 'coming soon'; limited-time Paze offer ended 2026-09-10 [S066].

2026-10-08: Discover Deposit Account Agreement update — outgoing wires requestable online, in the Discover App or by form with multi-level verification; 'Outgoing Wire Transfer $30' service charge; Add Cash limits $1,000/txn and per 24 h [S929].
2026-11-02: FedNow participant list (XLSX) includes 'CAPITAL ONE, NA, MCLEAN, VA'; no Discover Bank entry; list carries no participation-type column [S901].
2026-11-05: Capital One Intellix Mobile Android updated (package com.capitalone.intellix.mobile.prod; 3.8★, 167 reviews) [S926].
2026 (Jan 20–Oct 30): Capital One Mobile iOS 6.38.0 → 6.56.1, 25 releases with generic notes [S925].
2026-04-09: Capital One published a Paze explainer (activation via one-time SMS passcode + CVV, or by signing in) [S915].
Discover.com online-banking site reduced to a 'Discover is part of Capital One' landing page; only Forms & Documents (agreements, wire-request instructions) survive [S928].

2026-06-11 (network-level): Early Warning Services announced Zelle cross-border P2P (India first, planned before end-2026) and a ZelleUSD (ZLUSD) stablecoin; Capital One has not announced customer availability [S953].
RTP/FedNow send capability and any customer-facing instant payment product (consumer, SMB or Intellix) — no bank page found; FedNow participant XLSX could not be opened.
Whether a Zelle scam-warning interstitial exists on the send screen — not documented in help center.
Zelle scheduled/recurring payment UI (disclosure references 'Zelle Scheduled Payments' but no help article).
eBill enrollment and autopay flow steps on the New Bill Pay; Bill Pay vendor.
Small business ACH origination steps, limits, cutoffs, dual approval and user permission tiers; whether a business bill-pay/AP vendor is embedded.
Intellix web payment screens, approval tiers, ACH positive pay, information reporting and any API offering — portal is a login wall.

Discover legacy journeys (Zelle, Bill Pay UI, transfers, wires) — Discover feature pages removed/redirected; only the Bill Pay terms PDF survives. Discover outgoing wire policy (historically phone-only) could not be re-verified (.
Exact cancel/edit UI path for scheduled and recurring transfers.
Inbound alert/notification behavior for Zelle receipt, ACH credits and instant payments.
External account instant-verification mechanism (aggregator vendor).

RTP/FedNow SEND capability: still undeterminable — the FedNow XLSX (2026-11-02) and TCH list have no send/receive-only column; the bank acknowledges only receiving 'instant transfers'. Would need a Capital One disclosure, an EFT-agreement update or a Nacha/TCH send-participant list.
Zelle send-screen scam interstitial: still undocumented on any public page after re-reading the full Zelle FAQ and help article; requires an authenticated session.
Zelle 'Scheduled payments' UI path: marketed on the product page but no article; requires authenticated session.
Intellix web screens, user permission tiers and any API: no public page exists (all candidate URLs 404); portal is a login wall.
Small-business ACH origination screens, cutoffs and limits in standard business online banking: no public article; only fee/availability facts (free ACH; 1–3 business days).
Whether the SMB 'Accounts Payable' dashboard has its own approval workflow or user roles.

push_to_card: the verified dataset says false (INFERRED: no bank-originated send product) while the participation baseline participation says 'unknown'; receipt of Visa Direct/Mastercard Send credits on Capital One debit cards not assessed. Needs a bank disclosure/app screen or network participant list (COF-C013).

Mobile deposit availability for savings: Mobile deposits help (S021) says generally next business day for checking, savings and MMA; Deposit support (S085) says most savings deposits have a 4-business-day hold. Needs current Funds Availability Policy (COF-C014).
Will Capital One enable Zelle cross-border (India) / ZelleUSD for its customers, and when? (COF-C012)
Cancel cut-off and UI path for scheduled non-Zelle internal/external transfers (COF-C002/C003).
